When will I use this?

Indices and exponential change: when will I use this?

Whenever something doubles or halves again and again.

Vehicle body repairer

Engineering and manufacturing

\(\displaystyle t = \dfrac{8}{2^n}\)

n is the number of 3 dB steps above 85 dB

How long is safe in a 94 dB workshop?

Noise is measured in decibels. Every 3 dB more is double the noise, so the safe time halves. At 85 dB the limit is about 8 hours a day.

  1. 88 dB: \(8 \div 2 = 4\) hours.
  2. 91 dB: \(8 \div 2^{2} = 2\) hours.
  3. 94 dB: \(8 \div 2^{3} = 1\) hour.

The answer: \(8 \div 2^{3} = 1\) hour at 94 dB
